integrity: The domain-wall argument is attributed to the 2007 primary source, while the new proposed theorem is the global strict convex-order spacing classification. Computations supplement the universal proof. No independent mathematical assessment has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Alternating binary fixed opinions on a finite undirected cycle with homogeneous nearest-neighbor voter copying; stationary population count only. No claim for general graphs, nonalternating placements or transient-time risk. Historical priority remains provisional because the all-convex-order literature may have unlocated equivalent formulations.
title: Convex-order optimal spacing of alternating fixed opinions on a finite voter cycle
